title: Pearl: A Multimodal Culturally-Aware Arabic Instruction Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on the Pearl and Pearl-X benchmarks, which consist of multimodal image-question pairs related to Arab cultural heritage. The evaluation measures cultural understanding and Western bias mitigation using closed-form accuracy for multiple-choice/true-false questions, and an LVLM-as-judge to score open-ended responses based on correctness, coherence, detail, fluency, and a Cultural Awareness Score (CAS).
